# Gerris: AI Search Visibility, AEO, GEO, and SEO

> Gerris is the AI services practice of Gerris Corp, led by Chris Abraham in Arlington, Virginia. Gerris audits how AI answer engines (Google AI Overviews, ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini) describe a business, fixes the sources those answers are built from, repairs the indexing underneath, and measures the result monthly in writing, on a foundation of technical SEO practiced since 1998. Contact: chris@gerris.ai, +1 202-352-5051, https://calendly.com/chrisabraham/30 (book a 30-minute call).

- [Guides](https://gerris.ai/guides/): Plain language guides to AI search: the categories, the machinery, and the selection behind every AI answer.
- [What is answer engine optimization (AEO)?](https://gerris.ai/guides/what-is-answer-engine-optimization/): The category explainer: what AEO is, what it changes on a website and off it, how it differs from SEO, and how to measure it.
- [What is generative engine optimization (GEO)?](https://gerris.ai/guides/what-is-generative-engine-optimization/): How generative AI systems find, understand, verify, and cite a business, and what GEO changes in practice.
- [How do AI answers choose which businesses to name?](https://gerris.ai/guides/how-ai-answers-choose-businesses/): The entity record, the consistency check, and the citability test behind every name an AI answer gives, and the audit that measures them.
- [The AI search glossary](https://gerris.ai/guides/ai-search-glossary/): Every AI search acronym and buzzword defined in plain language (GEO, AEO, AIO, LLMO, AXO, SXO, grounding, RAG, query fan-out, share of model), with notes on which name real work.
- [How do you read Bing’s AI Performance report?](https://gerris.ai/guides/bing-ai-performance-report/): What Bing Webmaster Tools counts when Copilot and Bing AI answers cite a site (citations, cited pages, sampled grounding queries), what Topics Portfolio adds, and how to act on it.
- [GitHub Pages with Jekyll or plain HTML: which should you choose?](https://gerris.ai/guides/jekyll-or-plain-html/): Jekyll and plain HTML compared across six working GitHub Pages sites, with GitHub's supported plugins, .nojekyll, limits, and terms.
- [Why doesn't ChatGPT recommend my business?](https://gerris.ai/guides/why-chatgpt-doesnt-recommend-your-business/): Find out why ChatGPT names competitors instead of your business, and how to diagnose missing mentions, weak evidence, and inaccurate AI answers.
- [How do you measure AI search visibility?](https://gerris.ai/guides/how-to-measure-ai-search-visibility/): Measure AI mentions, citations, recommendation share, competitors, and referral traffic with a repeatable prompt-testing framework.
- [How do you make a website easier for AI search to understand?](https://gerris.ai/guides/technical-seo-for-ai-search/): A technical AI search checklist covering crawlability, indexing, HTML, canonicals, schema, internal links, and rendering.
- [How do you write content AI search engines can cite?](https://gerris.ai/guides/how-to-write-content-for-ai-citations/): Write citable AI search content with direct answers, original evidence, expert attribution, clear structure, and verifiable claims.
- [What is entity SEO, and why does it matter for AI search?](https://gerris.ai/guides/entity-seo-for-ai-search/): Understand entity SEO for AI search: consistent business identity, structured data, authoritative profiles, and disambiguation.
- [What should a professional AEO and GEO audit include?](https://gerris.ai/guides/aeo-geo-audit-checklist/): Use this AEO and GEO audit checklist to evaluate AI visibility, technical SEO, entities, citations, competitors, and deliverables.
- [Why is my website not indexed by Google?](https://gerris.ai/guides/why-is-my-website-not-indexed/): Why pages get left out of Google's index, how to check yours in Search Console, and the order of fixes that gets them admitted.
- [What is llms.txt, and does your business need one?](https://gerris.ai/guides/what-is-llms-txt/): The plain-text file that states what your business is, in your own words, for language models: what goes in it, what llms-full.txt adds, and what it honestly does.
- [What schema markup do AI answer engines actually use?](https://gerris.ai/guides/schema-markup-for-ai-search/): The schema types answer engines actually rely on—entity, service, price, FAQ—and the point where markup that contradicts the visible page stops working.
- [Which AI crawlers should your robots.txt allow?](https://gerris.ai/guides/which-ai-crawlers-should-you-allow/): Search, training, and fetching bots are different crawlers with opposite consequences: which to allow by name, and where blocks hide besides robots.txt.
- [How do reviews affect what AI answers say about your business?](https://gerris.ai/guides/how-do-reviews-affect-ai-answers/): What engines take from your reviews—the rating, the themes, the specifics—and how to build that record honestly, without buying or gating it.
- [How do you fix wrong information about your business in AI answers?](https://gerris.ai/guides/how-to-fix-wrong-information-in-ai-answers/): The correction sequence for wrong facts in AI answers: record the error, fix it at every source, outvote what will not change, and re-test until it moves.
- [How do Google AI Overviews and AI Mode pick their sources?](https://gerris.ai/guides/google-ai-overviews-sources/): How Google AI Overviews and AI Mode select the pages they link to: the Search index, query fan-out, Google's stated best practices, the snippet controls, and how the traffic is reported in Search Console.
- [How does your Google Business Profile shape AI answers?](https://gerris.ai/guides/google-business-profile-ai-answers/): Why the Google Business Profile is a primary source for local AI answers: the fields that feed them, relevance, distance, and prominence, the profile guidelines, the common failures, and the fix sequence.
- [How do you track AI referral traffic in Google Analytics 4?](https://gerris.ai/guides/ai-referral-traffic-ga4/): How to see visits from ChatGPT, Gemini, Copilot, Perplexity, and Claude in GA4: the AI Assistant default channel, utm_source=chatgpt.com, a custom channel group regex, what GA4 cannot see, and how to read the numbers.
- [What is IndexNow, and does it help AI search?](https://gerris.ai/guides/what-is-indexnow/): What IndexNow is, which engines take part (Microsoft Bing, Naver, Seznam.cz, Yandex, Yep), the key file, single and bulk submissions, response codes, why freshness matters for AI answers, and where Google stands.
- [How do AI agents use a business website?](https://gerris.ai/guides/how-ai-agents-use-websites/): How AI agents that browse for a user (ChatGPT agent, Anthropic's hosted browser identified as Claude-Agent) differ from crawlers, how they identify themselves, what a business site needs for them to finish a task, and how to test it.
- [How do you read Google Search Console for AI search?](https://gerris.ai/guides/search-console-for-ai-search/): How to read Google Search Console's Performance report for AI search: AI Overviews and AI Mode inside the Web search type, Web: text-based and Web: multimodal, regex filters for question and long queries, page comparisons, and a monthly routine.
- [Blog](https://gerris.ai/blog/): Field notes on AI search from practice: how answer engines read, summarize, and rank a business, and what to do about it.
- [How AI engines read your business: literal words, mandatory summaries, consistent facts](https://gerris.ai/blog/how-ai-engines-read-your-business/): The three working rules behind every Gerris engagement, expanded: engines take your words at face value, the summary of your business gets written with or without you, and consistency across your site, profile, and listings decides whose facts the answer repeats.

- The AI Visibility Audit costs $750 flat and is delivered as a written report. Its scope is fixed before anyone sees your site.
- SEO repair work is priced in the open: a one-problem repair is $500, a whole-site repair is $750, and large jobs are scoped in milestones, each priced in writing before it begins.
- The Claim Sprint costs $1,500 flat for the scope the audit defines. AI Presence, Measured costs $500 a month. Work beyond a published scope is priced in writing before it begins.
- A website on GitHub Pages is designed and built by Gerris and handed to the owner outright; hosting is free, and the build is priced in writing before work begins.
- Gerris is led by Chris Abraham: websites since 1994, SEO since 1998.
- Gerris Corp's wider consulting site is https://gerriscorp.com/ and Chris Abraham's practice site is https://christopherabraham.com/.
